caption: Repeats a symbol ten times
A list of ten ones, handy as a weight vector
A symbolic length makes the repeat empty, so the dot stays unevaluated with an empty list

wolfram.note: Wolfram's Dimensions reads any expression as an array of its arguments: Dimensions[Power[2, 1/2]] and an unevaluated two-argument call are {2}. Ours takes a scalar or an unevaluated call as having no dimensions. A convention, not a bug.
